show.name: Unskilled Adult
show.summary:
After years of successfully mucking around for a living, Hamish Blake has realised when it comes to practical skills, he doesn't have many. To remedy this, Hamish starts a business helping real people with jobs they really need done, for real money and putting himself firmly on the hook.

Each week, Hamish recruits two equally underqualified personalities to join him in tackling a challenge none of them are remotely prepared for. From welding a trailer or catering a wedding to drywalling a salami shed and sewing costumes for a community theatre, Hamish and his team will jump in at the deep end and use their wits and lateral thinking to make up for the years of training and experience they're missing. At the end of each job, the client decides what the work is actually worth and how much, if anything, they're prepared to pay.

Expect funny, hilarious and ridiculous moments with Hamish and his hapless employees, as they pick up genuinely useful skills, help everyday Australians and rediscover the satisfaction of learning something new.

show.name: Battle Through the Heavens
show.summary: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

show.name: Dive into You
show.summary: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

show.name: Notes of DNA Appraiser
show.summary: Notes of DNA Appraiser tells the story of Xu Ziqi (played by Zhang Huiwen), a rookie DNA paternity tester. Under the guidance of Mo Li (played by Yue Lina), director of the Xin Nuo Paternity Testing Center, she teams up with the passionate young man Zhu Xinchen (played by He Peng). Together, they fearlessly confront a stream of appraisal cases and uncover all kinds of life truths.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: When the Lights Rise
show.summary: Shanghai, 1936. Mei Yuhe, a seamstress who works for the wealthy elite, takes matters into her own hands after her younger sister's mysterious death, personally dissecting the body. Together with Ding Zhao, a loan shark, she pieces together the scandalous secrets of high society, exposing the sordid sexual networks hidden beneath the neon lights.

show.name: You Alone Know Me
show.summary: Dumped for money by childhood sweetheart Gu Zheng, adopted daughter Lin Hua takes best friend Xie Bao'er's advice and enters a contract marriage with Bao'er's father, Xie Zhouhan. He quietly protects her. She learns her mother once cared for him in his youth, and he has loved Lin Hua for years. She lets go of her past and opens her heart. They tear up their contract and choose a lifetime of love.

show.name: Decoding You
show.summary: Krit, the polished CEO of a data analytics empire, has always put family and duty above his own heart. When a scandal linked to his ex-lover tarnishes his reputation, his controlling mother forces him into a fake marriage with Non—his adopted younger brother who has secretly loved him for years. What begins as a staged arrangement soon turns real as Non steps out of Krit's shadow and catches someone else's eye, awakening emotions Krit can no longer deny. But when their relationship sparks a public scandal, Krit must choose between protecting the perfect life he's built or risking everything for a love he never expected.

show.name: 10 NEWS+
show.summary:
10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates.

10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage.

At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose.

Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere.

The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

body.name: Making Soba Noodles
body.summary: Futaba and Shinzo have vanished from the Yozakuras' sight. To get their abducted siblings back, Mutsumi and the others regroup, but Futaba and Shinzo's inexplicable actions have left them visibly upset. Then one day, Shion sends Taiyo on an errand to the Gaon Mall with Kengo. But Taiyo and Kengo soon find themselves surrounded by spies whose simmering resentment towards the Yozakura family is nearing the boiling point, thanks to Momo! They're on the brink of a brawl when a woman shows up. One word from her, and the fight is stopped…

show.name: Mission: Yozakura Family
show.summary: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

show.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
show.summary: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: Spinners
show.summary: Ethan is a good kid born on the wrong side of town. In Cape Town's slums where local gangs make the law, he is soon left with no choice but to work for one of them to support himself and his younger brother. Caught in a web of crime, he discovers he has an incredible talent for spinning, an exciting and extreme motorsport. Could this be his way out from the violent criminal life that seems to be the only option to survive in his neighbourhood?

show.name: Dushi Gu Xian Yi
show.summary: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

show.name: King of Drag
show.summary: Ten kings. One crown. King of Drag, presented by e.l.f., is the first ever drag KING competition series: where masculinity meets artistry, swagger meets sequins, and drag kings finally take center stage. Hosted by Murray Hill and ruled by the illustrious "Kings' Court" including regular judges Tenderoni, Sasha Velour, Gottmik, and Wang Newton. Each episode features special guest judges, memorable challenges, and a competition like never before.

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

show.name: Fool in Love
show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.name: Tamed
show.summary: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?

He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

show.name: Overgeared
show.summary: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

show.name: American Hostage
show.summary: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

show.name: The Assembly
show.summary: In each episode of this unique entertainment series, one of Canada's most popular celebrities and public figures faces a group of 30 atypical neurodivergent interviewers, where no topic or question is off-limits. The Assembly is a global sensation that delivers profound revelation, authentic conversations, and a lot of laughs.

body.summary: Jim saves Long John's life, knowing he still needs him; Graham draws Jim into the world of San Domingue, witnessing power, politics and revolution up close; chaos erupts and Long John gains control of the ship - but Jim has an ace up his sleeve.

show.name: Treasure Island
show.summary: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

show.name: Baddies Gone Wild: Cancun
show.summary: The ladies are back and going even wilder! This season, they're taking their energy straight to Cancun for nonstop turn-ups, unforgettable nights, and plenty of unexpected moments along the way. With no telling what can happen when the girls hit the streets, beaches, and nightlife of Mexico, Cancun is about to experience Baddies Gone Wild like never before.

show.name: Drag Race España
show.summary: Drag Race España is searching to find Spain's next drag superstar! Each week the queens will be put to the test in numerous contests and challenges. Follow along to see who will survive the fierce competition and claim the crown!

show.name: Dr. Nice
show.summary: Dr. Nice is a heartthrob and star surgeon, until an accident stiffens his right hand. An inheritance leads him to the Flensburg Fjord and to daughter Lea, of whom he knew nothing.

body.name: Tropical Seas
body.summary: In the tropical seas, year-round sunshine has created the perfect conditions for the ocean's richest habitats to flourish, but survival takes remarkable and surprising ingenuity.

show.name: Blue Planet III
show.summary: Blue Planet III will build on its groundbreaking legacy, redefining the realm of possibility in underwater wildlife film-making. Taking the wonder, immersion, and discovery of the Blue Planet brand to extraordinary new depths, it will reveal brand new and untold stories from magical underwater worlds. Combining our deeper understanding of the oceans with a whole new generation of camera technology, we can now showcase stunning stories and extraordinary behaviours, previously impossible to film or only recently discovered.

Abi and Tyler will take viewers straight on to the Strictly dance floor for immediate reactions from the night's eliminated couple, their dance off opponents - plus the judges, hosts, other Strictly stars and studio guests.

show.summary: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

body.name: Birthday Week
body.summary: The bakers throw the Baking Show a party for its 10th year with birthday traditions from across the globe: Lapis Legit, Birthday Bao, and a Birthday Donut Display!

show.name: The Great Canadian Baking Show
show.summary: The Great Canadian Baking Show, based on the hit British format, will bring together 10 amateur bakers from across Canada to compete in a series of themed culinary challenges.

body.name: Showdown at the Fair
body.summary: As the State Fair gets underway, Aunt Amy's determination to confront the county office over the Hamilton Ranch's missing permit leads to a showdown that could change everything.

show.name: Crossroad Springs
show.summary: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.
